en_us: The other mods' crops in raised beds, and the machines that reap them.
es_es: Los cultivos de los otros mods en canteros, y las máquinas que los cosechan.

hover.en_us: Back to the Sun of Heliodor

en_us.title: One frame, five machines
text: [lead] Five Mystical Agriculture machines are built on a [item:mysticalagriculture:machine_frame|Machine Frame].
[li] Recipe: iron, redstone and stone.
[li] Furnace, harvester, seed reprocessor, soul extractor and soulium spawner.
[li] All five burn solid fuel.

es_es.title: Un marco, cinco máquinas
text: [lead] Cinco máquinas de Mystical Agriculture se arman sobre un [item:mysticalagriculture:machine_frame|Marco de máquina].
[li] Receta: hierro, redstone y piedra.
[li] Horno, cosechadora, reprocesador de semillas, extractora de almas y generador de soulium.
[li] Las cinco queman combustible sólido.

en_us.title: A farmhand that never sleeps
en_us.subtitle: Replants, too. Unlike some people.
text: [lead] Facing a field, the [item:mysticalagriculture:harvester|Harvester] picks ripe crops and replants them.
[li] Recipe: [b|2] diamond scythes, [b|2] soulium ingots, iron and a frame.
[li] It keeps the harvest inside; redstone pauses it.
[li] It works a [b|3×3] patch; every upgrade tier adds a ring, up to [b|15×15].

es_es.title: Un peón que no duerme
es_es.subtitle: Y replanta. No como otros.
text: [lead] Mirando al campo, la [item:mysticalagriculture:harvester|Cosechadora] junta lo maduro y lo replanta.
[li] Receta: [b|2] guadañas de diamante, [b|2] lingotes de soulium, hierro y un marco.
[li] Guarda la cosecha adentro; la redstone la pausa.
[li] Trabaja un cuadro de [b|3×3]; cada nivel de mejora suma un anillo, hasta [b|15×15].

en_us.title: A furnace that takes upgrades
text: [lead] Mystical Agriculture's [item:mysticalagriculture:furnace|Furnace] smelts like any other until it gets an upgrade.
[li] Recipe: [b|2] furnaces, [b|2] prosperity ingots, iron and a frame.

es_es.title: Un horno que acepta mejoras
text: [lead] El [item:mysticalagriculture:furnace|Horno] de Mystical Agriculture funde como cualquiera hasta que le ponés una mejora.
[li] Receta: [b|2] hornos, [b|2] lingotes de prosperidad, hierro y un marco.

en_us.title: Spare seeds into essence
text: [lead] The [item:mysticalagriculture:seed_reprocessor|Seed Reprocessor] turns every spare seed into [b|2] essences of its crop.
[li] Recipe: [b|2] soulium ingots, [b|2] iron hoes, iron and a frame.
[li] One seed every [b|10] seconds, faster with upgrades.
[li] The second seeds from essence farmland finally have a use.

es_es.title: Semillas de sobra a esencia
text: [lead] El [item:mysticalagriculture:seed_reprocessor|Reprocesador de semillas] vuelve cada semilla de sobra [b|2] esencias de su cultivo.
[li] Receta: [b|2] lingotes de soulium, [b|2] azadas de hierro, hierro y un marco.
[li] Una semilla cada [b|10] segundos, más rápido con mejoras.
[li] Las segundas semillas de la tierra de esencia por fin sirven.

en_us.title: Faster machines
text: [lead] Machine upgrades speed up all five frame machines.
[li:mysticalagriculture:upgrade_base] Shards, prosperity ingots and a diamond make the [item:mysticalagriculture:upgrade_base|Machine Upgrade Base].
[li:mysticalagriculture:inferium_upgrade] [b|4] inferium and [b|4] inferium ingots turn it into the [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_upgrade|Inferium Machine Upgrade].
{page}
[li] Each tier wraps the previous upgrade in four essences and four ingots of its own.
[li] Upgraded machines work faster and burn more fuel; the harvester reaches further.

es_es.title: Máquinas más rápidas
text: [lead] Las mejoras de máquina aceleran las cinco máquinas con marco.
[li:mysticalagriculture:upgrade_base] Fragmentos, lingotes de prosperidad y un diamante dan la [item:mysticalagriculture:upgrade_base|Base de mejora de máquina].
[li:mysticalagriculture:inferium_upgrade] [b|4] inferium y [b|4] lingotes de inferium la vuelven la [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_upgrade|Mejora de máquina de inferium].
{page}
[li] Cada nivel envuelve la mejora anterior en cuatro esencias y cuatro lingotes propios.
[li] Las máquinas mejoradas trabajan más rápido y queman más; la cosechadora llega más lejos.

en_us.title: Second gear
text: [lead] The [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_upgrade|Prudentium Machine Upgrade] is the inferium one plus [b|4] prudentium and [b|4] prudentium ingots.
[li] Machines take [b|62.5%] of the time.
[li] The harvester works [b|7×7].

es_es.title: Segunda marcha
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_upgrade|Mejora de máquina de prudentium] es la de inferium más [b|4] prudentium y [b|4] lingotes de prudentium.
[li] Las máquinas tardan el [b|62,5%] del tiempo.
[li] La cosechadora trabaja [b|7×7].

en_us.title: Third gear
text: [lead] The [item:mysticalagriculture:tertium_upgrade|Tertium Machine Upgrade] wraps the prudentium one in [b|4] tertium and [b|4] tertium ingots.
[li] Machines take [b|40%] of the time.
[li] The harvester works [b|9×9].

es_es.title: Tercera marcha

[li] Las máquinas tardan el [b|40%] del tiempo.
[li] La cosechadora trabaja [b|9×9].

en_us.title: Eight times faster
en_us.subtitle: Faster, and hungrier.

[li] Recipe: the tertium upgrade, [b|4] imperium and [b|4] imperium ingots.
[li] It burns fuel [b|16] times as fast; the harvester works [b|11×11].

es_es.subtitle: Más rápido, y más glotón.

[li] Receta: la mejora de tertium, [b|4] imperium y [b|4] lingotes de imperium.
